summary: Date-format conversion routine called with one parameter mapped by DSECT COCDATFT (app/maclib/COCDATFT.mac:17-23), the Assembler view of CODATECN-REC (app/cpy/CODATECN.cpy:17-52). Type 1 input YYYYMMDD becomes YYYY-MM-DD; type 2 input YYYY-MM-DD becomes YYYYMMDD; anything else sets COERMSG to 'INVALID INPUT'. R15 is always cleared before return (app/asm/COBDATFT.asm:61), so callers can only detect failure through COERMSG.

existing_rules_reviewed.note: VALIDIN1 rejects when COINPDT+4 (the fifth input character) equals '-' or COOUTYPE is '2' (lines 36-39), otherwise copies the year and inserts hyphens at COOUTDT+4 and COOUTDT+7 (lines 40-44). The rejection branches to GOTOERR (line 55), which leaves COOUTDT unchanged.

VALIDIN2 rejects only when COOUTYPE is '1' (lines 49-50); the hyphen check is commented out (lines 47-48). Otherwise it copies input positions 0-3, 5-6 and 8-9 to the output (lines 51-53). The only caller, CBACT01C, passes type '2' with output type '2' (app/cbl/CBACT01C.cbl:225-231), which takes this path.

A COINTYPE other than '1' or '2' falls through the CLI tests at lines 30-33 to B GOTOERR (line 34); GOTOERR moves 'INVALID INPUT' to COERMSG (lines 55-56). The cited range 34-56 in the legacy rule omits the type tests at lines 30-33; the review cites 30-56.

observations: R15 is set to zero by SR R15,R15 at app/asm/COBDATFT.asm:61 on every path, including the error path, so the return code never signals failure. Confirmed.

COERMSG is not cleared on the success paths (lines 40-45 and 51-54); a caller reusing CODATECN-REC would see a stale message unless it clears the field. Confirmed from code; caller behaviour in CBACT01C is not checked here.
